cheatsheet.ex: Every new user goes through KYC.
Our AML team reviews large transfers.
We need a recent proof of address.
We onboard about fifty clients a day.
The process must be compliant with GDPR.
I escalated the case to compliance.

cards.back: подтверждение адреса (счёт за свет, выписка из банка)

audio.text: Please upload a utility bill from the last three months as proof of address.

options: Счёт за коммуналку за последние 3 месяца

audio.text: Any transfer over ten thousand euros is flagged and reviewed by the AML team.

cards.text: Every new user goes through KYC before the first payment.
cards.tr: Каждый новый пользователь проходит KYC до первого платежа.

cards.text: The system flagged the transaction, so I escalated it to the AML team.
cards.tr: Система пометила операцию, поэтому я передал(а) её AML-команде.

n1.say: Thanks for coming in. What do you know about KYC?
n1.tr: Спасибо, что пришли. Что вы знаете о KYC?

choices.text: It's how we verify a customer's identity, usually with an ID, a selfie, and proof of address.
It's something about security, I think.
choices.feedback: Слишком размыто. Назови шаги: ID, selfie, proof of address.

n2.say: Good. A transaction gets flagged at midnight. What do you do?
n2.tr: Хорошо. Ночью система пометила операцию. Что будете делать?

choices.text: I'd check the details and escalate it to the AML team if it looks suspicious.
I'd follow our internal procedure and document everything.

n3.say: A customer is angry because their account is frozen. How do you handle it?
n3.tr: Клиент злится, что счёт заморожен. Как поступите?

choices.text: I'd stay calm, explain that we need extra documents, and give a clear timeline.
I'd tell them the exact reason we flagged them.
choices.feedback: Осторожно: детали AML-проверки раскрывать нельзя (tipping off). Скажи, какие документы нужны.

n4.say: Exactly. Why do you want to work in fintech?
n4.tr: Именно. Почему вы хотите работать в финтехе?

choices.text: I like fast-moving products, and I care about keeping payments safe and compliant.
I speak four languages, so I can help customers across Europe.

n5.say: Great answers. We'll be in touch by Friday.
n5.tr: Отличные ответы. Свяжемся с вами до пятницы.
